description: This Java source file defines a final class AcknowledgementAggregatorActorStarter used for starting and managing acknowledgement aggregator actors within an Akka-based system. It contains logic for actor lifecycle management, header validation, and signal processing related to acknowledgement handling in the context of a software project that interacts with the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorActorStarter
classes.description: This class provides mechanisms to start, manage, and coordinate acknowledgment aggregator actors in an Akka environment, ensuring proper header validation, actor naming, and signal preprocessing for acknowledgement workflows.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AcknowledgementAggregatorActorStarter with specified context, config, header translator, and ack request setters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the process of starting an acknowledgement aggregator actor for a given signal if necessary, based on the signal's acknowledgement requests and headers.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Preprocesses a signal before starting an acknowledgment aggregator, including header validation and deciding whether to start the actor.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initiates the actual start of the acknowledgment aggregator actor and notifies a consumer upon startup completion.

methods.name: startAckAggregatorActor
methods.description: Creates and starts the AckAggregator actor instance with proper props and a unique name based on the signal and internal counter.

methods.name: getNextActorName
methods.description: Generates a unique actor name based on the signal's correlation ID and an internal counter.

methods.name: buildAckRequestSetter
methods.description: Constructs a composite PartialFunction to set acknowledgment requests on signals based on provided setters.

methods.name: getDittoHeaderInvalidException
methods.description: Validates the signal's headers, particularly timeout headers, and returns an Optional containing an exception if headers are invalid.

methods.name: shouldStartForIncoming
methods.description: Determines if an acknowledgment aggregator should start for an incoming signal based on its type and acknowledgment requests.
